scientific_integrity: The founding Borel/compound-Poisson representation, classical Poisson maxima identity, and inverse-Gaussian sum limit are acknowledged as earlier mathematics. Numeric checks are illustrative and do not substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed positive mean and critical-window parameter and thresholds in compact positive subsets are covered.
No finite-sample exact single crossing or second nonzero coefficient at the asymptotic cancellation point is established.
Historical priority is provisional, and independent verification has not been conducted.
title: A universal first-order bias reversal for largest Borel clans in near-critical generalized Poisson samples
